ABOUT THE ROLE
:
The fire protection technician keeps facility fire and life safety systems working: fire suppression, sprinklers, fire alarm and detection, extinguishers, and related life safety equipment. This is a field role. You inspect, test, troubleshoot, and support the installation and commissioning of systems that protect people and high-density computing. GPU racks and industrial processes can and do catch fire.
You will work with facilities, contractors, and the local fire marshal. You are not the design engineer of record. You are the technician who ensures the as-built system is installed, tested, and kept in service.
RESPONSIBILITIES
:
Inspect, test, and maintain fire and life safety systems (sprinklers, suppression, alarms, detection, extinguishers) and close out deficiencies
Support installation, upgrades, and commissioning of fire protection systems: walkdowns, device checkout, punch lists, functional tests, and turnover
Verify that installed systems stay in working order and that impairments are logged, mitigated, and restored
Work with facilities teams, fire contractors, and the authority having jurisdiction (fire marshal) on inspections, permits, impairments, and certifications
Read drawings, submittals, and test reports well enough to follow a job in the field and flag what does not match
Keep inspection, test, and corrective-action records so audits and AHJ visits have a clean paper trail
Respond to impairments, leaks, trouble signals, and after-hours issues as the site requires

High school diploma or equivalency certificate
2+ years installing, inspecting, testing, and/or servicing fire protection systems (sprinkler, fire alarm, and/or special suppression)
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

Working knowledge of NFPA standards and basic building/fire code requirements for systems you work on (for example NFPA 13, 25, 72)
NICET certification in Inspection and Testing, Water-Based Systems, Fire Alarm, or Special Hazards
Hands-on time with ESFR, fire pumps, preaction, clean agent, or other industrial / warehouse / data-center suppression
OEM or vendor experience (Simplex, Siemens, Notifier, Viking, Reliable, or similar)
Construction or commissioning experience on active jobsites
OSHA 10/30 or equivalent site-safety training

Willing to work extended hours as needed, including the current 6-day / 12-hour construction cadence

jobs.description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.
We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important.
All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
We are seeking exceptional Electrical Engineers to join our growing team in Memphis and help design, build, and optimize the power infrastructure for SpaceXAI's high-density AI supercomputing facilities. This is a broad Electrical Engineer requisition covering three critical focus areas:
Battery Storage Electrical Engineering
(BESS, PCS, integration, controls)
Power Transmission Electrical Engineering
(high-voltage lines, substations, grid interconnection)
Power Generation Electrical Engineering
(on-site gas turbine generators, synchronization, protection)
You will work on one or more of these areas depending on your expertise and business needs, collaborating across electrical, mechanical, power systems, and construction teams to deliver reliable, massive-scale power solutions. This is a full-time, onsite role based in the Memphis region.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Design and engineer electrical systems for on-site power generation, high-voltage transmission, and large-scale battery energy storage supporting AI superclusters.
Develop single-line diagrams, protection & control schematics, relay settings, and interconnection designs.
Perform detailed power system studies (load flow, short circuit, arc flash, transient stability, harmonics) using ETAP, PSS/E, or equivalent tools.
Integrate electrical systems with generators, battery storage, transmission infrastructure, and data center loads.
Ensure compliance with relevant standards (NERC, ERCOT, IEEE, NEC, NFPA, UL) and support permitting and utility coordination.
Support equipment specification, vendor selection, factory testing, site commissioning, and energization.
Conduct failure mode analysis (FMEA), root cause investigations, and reliability modeling to achieve extreme uptime targets.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on new facility builds, capacity expansions, and continuous improvement of power standards.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering or electrical engineering technology.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Experience in one or more of the following:
Battery Storage
: BESS, inverters/PCS, BMS integration, NFPA 855
Power Transmission
: High-voltage substations, transmission lines, grid interconnection (ERCOT)
Power Generation
: Gas turbine generators, excitation, synchronization, islanded operation
Background with data centers, hyperscale facilities, or large on-site power infrastructure (>50 MW).
Knowledge of ERCOT, NERC reliability standards, and utility interconnection processes.
Experience supporting construction, commissioning, and operations of power systems.
Track record of innovation or high-impact delivery in power infrastructure projects.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights
Must be able to work extended hours and weekends as needed; flexibility required
Remain focused while working in hazardous environments, while wearing appropriate PPE
Must be able to lift up to 25lbs unassisted
Travel up to 50% to other locations
Valid driver’s license
